_meta.description: Authoritative source registry for values used by TRIARCHY. This file is intentionally separate from the five locked gameplay contracts so NASA data can be refreshed without changing their schemas.
_meta.policy: A numeric value may be marked verified:true in a gameplay contract only when its source_id, product/version, spatial or table reference, units, and retrieval date are recorded here or in the field source text. Derived gameplay modifiers must remain identified as derived.
_meta.refresh_policy: Check source landing pages before each release and refresh snapshots when a source product version changes. Preserve the prior value and provenance in version control.

sources.title: Life Support Baseline Values and Assumptions Document, NASA/TP-2015-218570, Rev1
LOLA Reduced Data Records and gridded elevation products
sources.version_or_coverage: PDS LRO LOLA archive; consult product label for the selected raster version
sources.measurement_note: Record latitude, east-positive longitude, raster/product identifier, pixel resolution, and sampling method for every site value. Slope is derived from the selected elevation raster unless a documented LOLA slope product is used.

sources.title: LROC QuickMap lunar polar illumination layers
sources.version_or_coverage: Select and record the exact WAC polar illumination layer and its stated time interval
sources.measurement_note: Illumination percentage must retain the layer name, time interval, coordinates, and sampling method; it is then normalized to a solar-generation gameplay modifier.

sources.title: LEND Derived Data Records
sources.data_kind: neutron flux and hydrogen-related resource potential
sources.version_or_coverage: PDS LRO LEND archive, Release 67 current at retrieval
sources.measurement_note: LEND measures neutron flux. Any hydrogen abundance or water-potential value must name the derived product and units; it must never be presented as confirmed extractable water.

sources.title: Cosmic Ray Telescope for the Effects of Radiation data archive
sources.version_or_coverage: Use a documented CRaTER dose or flux product appropriate to the selected baseline
sources.measurement_note: CRaTER observations are orbital-environment data. Surface dose in the game is a separately documented derived model, adjusted by shielding and terrain factors.
